title: Explore the art of bourbon blending
description: At Bardstown Bourbon Company, compare how different barrels and whiskies contribute aroma and flavor to a final blend. Choose a tour or tasting that focuses on the distillery’s blending approach, and let your guide explain the choices behind each glass. Even a small sip can reveal how much craft is involved before a bottle reaches the shelf.
teaser: Taste the decisions behind a Kentucky bourbon blend.
goodToKnow: Special sessions happen periodically. Check the winter calendar; tasting alcohol is optional.
whyItMightDelightYou: It offers a new way to notice flavor, beyond simply deciding whether you like a whiskey.
